Package net.sourceforge.plantuml.ngdot.model

Class DotGraph

java.lang.Object
net.sourceforge.plantuml.ngdot.model.DotGraph
public final class DotGraph extends Object
A parsed DOT graph: the root subgraph, plus every node and edge in creation order. Built by DotGraphBuilder.
